links.outcome: Output stochasticity of LLM evaluators under API-based and batch inference
links.effect: API-based and batch inference inflate stochasticity in LLM evaluator outputs, indicating reproducibility problems that call for controlled deployment. No numbers given in the abstract.
links.quote: Finally, API-based and batch inference inflate stochasticity, underscoring the need for controlled deployment.

unlisted_practices: Validating LLM-as-judge evaluators against human expert raters
Controlling for response length and verbosity when using LLM evaluators
Avoiding self-evaluation, where an LLM judges outputs from its own model family

screen.reason: Evaluates LLMs used as automated evaluators/judges for clinical text responses compared against expert human clinicians, specifically testing self-preference bias, verbosity bias, and inference reproducibility.
